nodes.name: Save Error
nodes.notes: queryReplacement as an ARRAY (fix 2026-09-05). With a comma-separated list, a comma inside 'message' split the value and shifted the positions, and an empty 'executionId' was dropped: the INSERT failed with 'there is no parameter $4' and the durable trace was lost, which is exactly what M-A exists to guarantee. onError continueRegularOutput is deliberate: if saving fails, the alert still has to go out.

nodes.name: Notify
nodes.notes: INV-15 (corrected 2026-09-08): parse_mode has NO 'None' option and omitting it does NOT disable parsing - n8n sends Markdown anyway, and a key with an odd number of underscores kills the alert with a 400. HTML is set explicitly and & < > are escaped in every interpolation.

parameters.text: ={{ String($('Format').item.json.text).replaceAll('&','&').replaceAll('<','<').replaceAll('>','>') + '\n\n' + (() => { try { const id = String($('Save Error').first().json.id ?? ''); return /^\d+$/.test(id) ? 'Record: bot.errors #' + id : '⚠️ NO TRACE: this failure was not stored in bot.errors and will not show up in the daily watch.'; } catch (e) { return '⚠️ NO TRACE: this failure was not stored in bot.errors and will not show up in the daily watch.'; } })() }}

nodes.name: Mark Notified
nodes.notes: queryReplacement as an ARRAY (fix 2026-09-05). If 'Save Error' failed, the id comes back empty; with a comma-separated list that left zero parameters and the UPDATE blew up with 'there is no parameter $1'.

parameters.query: update bot.errors set notified = true where id = $1;
